item.title: Board of Peace will ask the UN Security Council to press Hamas to disarm
item.description: The body overseeing the U.S.-brokered ceasefire in Gaza plans to ask the United Nations Security Council to press Hamas to disarm

item.title: US test fires mobile rocket system near Mount Fuji in rapid 'shoot and scoot' drill
item.description: U.S. Marines test fired a dozen rockets from a HIMARS launcher near Mount Fuji in Japan, highlighting a weapon system that is becoming increasingly important to the U.S. military

item.title: Taiwan's Lai says he would tell Trump he hopes to continue arm purchases
item.description: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te says that if given the chance he would tell U.S. President Donald Trump he hopes to continue U.S. arms purchases that are essential for peace

item.title: Opposition leaders in the Bahamas demand probe after US ties politician to drug trafficking case
item.description: Opposition leaders in the Bahamas are demanding an investigation after a U.S. federal agent alleged that a suspected drug trafficker who survived a recent plane crash near Florida was rescued and found with roughly $30,000

item.description: Weapons are now regularly brandished in Tehran in an increasing show of defiance

item.description: The St. Michael’s Golden-Domed Monastery in Kyiv has become a place of mourning for many
